decisive_items: pyocele, which was marsupialized and drained
enlargement of the right sphenoid sinus with overdevelopment and opacity of the lateral recess

response.rationale: The surgical finding of a pyocele and negative histopathology for neoplasm and infection strongly support a sphenoid sinus mucocele. Imaging shows chronic bone changes and expansion, while the lack of response to steroids and absence of fungal/neoplastic evidence exclude the other candidates.

rejected.why: Histopathology negative for neoplastic cells contradicts schwannoma; imaging shows sinus-centered disease with pyocele.
Negative histopathology for hyphae and negative cultures make invasive fungal sinusitis unlikely despite imaging overlap.
No response to prednisone and imaging findings of sinus expansion with pyocele are not typical of Tolosa-Hunt syndrome.
